title: JWT signature is not verified (alg:none / stripped)
summary: The signed in JSON Web Token is accepted with its algorithm set to none or its signature removed, so anyone can mint a token for any account.  This is a full authentication bypass.

confirm.control: The signed out view of the same endpoint, which must differ from the signed in one.
confirm.differential: status==200 and same(response, authed) and differ(response, anon)

reproduce: Take the session JWT, set its header alg to "none" and drop the signature (keep the dot), and request an authenticated endpoint with it.  A signed in response means the signature is not checked.
remediate: Reject alg:none and any algorithm the server did not issue; always verify the signature with the expected key.
